From the owner
A fresh backsplash. A whole new feel. We replaced this kitchen’s stone backsplash with glossy white subway tile for a brighter, updated look that complements the existing wood cabinets. Trophy Tile & Bathroom Renovations provides professional kitchen backsplash installation, custom tile showers, and bathroom remodeling in Dawsonville and throughout North Georgia. Contact Mendy & Joey to schedule your estimate!
Oct 14, 2026
